description.text: The third enhanced expansion pack of the Sword & Shield series, released on 10 July 2020, which introduced the Amazing Rare, marked A: a special holo of a legendary or mythical Pokémon set against a burst of color. Its six Amazing Rare cards are Celebi, Raikou, Jirachi, Rayquaza, Zacian and Zamazenta. Each pack held seven cards, one of them a holo. The mythical Zarude appeared in the card game as Zarude V, with Alcremie VMAX, Togekiss VMAX and Coalossal VMAX and the Supporters Opal, Allister and Beauty. The cards are numbered to 76, with the Amazing Rare cards inside that numbering, followed by full-art Super Rare Pokémon V and Supporters, rainbow Hyper Rare Pokémon VMAX and Supporters, and gold Ultra Rare Oranguru, Hero's Medal and Cape of Toughness. In English most of its cards came out in Vivid Voltage in November 2020.
